mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 9.0% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high housing starts level (HOUST > 550.0) indicates strong consumer demand supporting corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 550.0, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC over last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signals strong labor market and accommodative policy, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor market and accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03.
